[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed key elements of a good detective story: an intriguing mystery, a skilled detective, suspects and red herrings, clues and evidence, a satisfying resolution, good pacing and tension, a well-crafted plot, and a strong sense of setting and atmosphere.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed key elements of a good noir detective film: a dark atmosphere, a hard-boiled detective, a complex plot, a femme fatale, moral ambiguity, sharp dialogue and voiceover narration, existential dread, and social commentary.
